description: Replace APIs, arguments and context keys that Airflow 3 removed with their supported replacements before upgrading.

violation.message: `$N` was removed in Airflow 3; compare `sys.version_info` instead.
`requires_access` was removed in Airflow 3; use the matching `requires_access_*` function from `airflow.api_fastapi.core_api.security`.
`airflow.contrib` was removed in Airflow 3; replace `$N` with its equivalent in a provider package or in core Airflow.
`DatasetEvent` is private in Airflow 3; annotate with `dict[str, Any]` instead.
`airflow.operators.subdag` was removed in Airflow 3; restructure the sub-workflow as a `TaskGroup`.
`days_ago` was removed in Airflow 3; use `pendulum.today('UTC').add(days=-N)` instead.
`mkdirs` was removed in Airflow 3; use `pathlib.Path(path).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)` instead.

The context key `triggering_dataset_events` was removed in Airflow 3; read `"triggering_asset_events"` instead.
Index `inlet_events` with an `Asset` object such as `inlet_events[Asset(uri=...)]`; string keys were removed in Airflow 3.
`external_trigger` was removed from `dag_run` in Airflow 3; check `dag_run.run_type` instead.
The parameter `$K` was removed in Airflow 3; derive what you need from `logical_date` or the `data_interval_*` context keys instead.
The `conf` parameter was removed from the task context in Airflow 3; import `conf` from `airflow.configuration` instead.
`$X` was removed from plugins in Airflow 3; import the extension as a regular Python module instead.
`apply_defaults` is applied automatically in Airflow 3; delete this decorator.
